items.title: Why AXT (AXTI) Is Up 11.6% After Indium Phosphide Supply Tightens Amid New AI Deals
items.summary: Earlier this week, reports that prices of indium phosphide substrates used in AI lasers may rise further amid supply tightness put fresh attention on AXT, which recently expanded its InP capacity and secured new supply agreements with Lumentum Holdings and Coherent Corp.
